Text: [solemn] {body-Drive}{WorriedA}Our stories used to be so simple. We had a beginning, a middle, and an end.
[tired] I... I can't tell you anything.
[solemn] {AngryA}But ever since we moved to this awful city... {SadA}everything's gotten so confused.
And I'm supposed to just believe you?
{AngryC}I just want you to be careful. {WorriedA}I almost lost you once, and--
{AngryB}I'm not going to be an errand girl for Crane anymore!

{worriedA}What is it with you two? {angryA}You and Gren are all, {sarcasticA}"Let's get a posse together," when there's no one around, {angryA}but as soon as the Big Bad Wolf walks in {sarcasticA}your tails go between your legs.
[it hurts to say] She was hooking. [beat] To pay down debt.
[through sniffles] Eventually, the only people she owed were at her work, you know, that shithole club. The Pudding 'n' Pie.
{SadA} {body-StandA}I work here, okay? I work the front desk. [beat; just running through it] It's to help pay rent.
[pickup2] [grunt of effort as he smashes the mirror]
